notes.title: Trophy Hunt: 100% Off!!
notes.notes:
To all of the 5 people who are keeping track of this game, It will soon be free! I hope to get more people playing it, mostly so that I can get better feedback and improve it. This change will be happening in early January 2024 and will remain in effect for the foreseeable future.

That being said, I'd like to give a massive shout out to all those who got the game prior to this change. My main goal with this project is create a game that family and friends can enjoy together. I greatly appreciate anyone who gives this game a shot(especially if they give feedback via any method). 

I'm continuing to work on this project, and am excited to make it the best it can be.
